items: 进入签到页面前先读取首屏任务状态，页面就绪后再完成切换。
快速切换页面会取消过期读取，并在页面正式可见后启动定期刷新。
任务删除与待清理凭据身份一同持久化；失败后可重试删除或重启继续清理，不影响其他任务。
严格校验签到响应，查询提交后的实际状态，并提供有界脱敏诊断。
统一任务编辑器的公共控件与确认行为。
新增塔吉多异环原生凭据、自动刷新、游戏签到与提交后状态确认。
塔吉多支持短信与密码网页登录，自动凭据保存前保持遮罩，取消保留原值。
开放五个平台网页登录，自动打开登录界面，并修复凭据认证、取消和保存重启恢复。
完善凭据提示及游戏选择框布局；任务运行记录只显示最近一次签到结果。

en-US.description: Create multi-platform game check-in tasks using host global notifications and local schedules.

items: Loads the initial task state before entering the check-in page and switches only after the page is ready.
Cancels superseded reads during rapid navigation and starts periodic refresh only after the page becomes visible.
Persist task deletion together with exact pending credential cleanup; retry after failure or restart without touching other tasks.
Validates check-in responses, confirms state after submission and provides bounded redacted diagnostics.
Aligns task editor controls and confirmation behavior with public frontend elements.
Adds Tajiduo native credentials, automatic refresh, NTE game check-in and state confirmation.
Adds Tajiduo SMS and password sign-in with masked credential drafts and cancellation that preserves existing credentials.
Enables browser login for all five platforms, opens login dialogs automatically, and improves credential validation, cancellation, and persistence.
Refines credential hints and game selection layout; each task displays only its latest sign-in run.

description: 创建多平台游戏签到任务，配置本机时区计划、手动执行、运行结果与宿主全局通知。
